subject: dsa
title: Contains Duplicate
summary: Keep a set of the values seen so far. For each number, a hit means a repeat; otherwise add it and move on.
problem: Return true if any value appears at least twice in nums, and false if every value is distinct.

steps.caption: Walk through nums once, remembering every value in a set. The first value we meet that's already in the set is a duplicate.
First is 1 (index 0). The set is empty, so 1 is a miss. Add it, recording where we first saw it.
Next is 2 (index 1). Not in the set yet — a miss. Add 2.
Then 3 (index 2). Still new — a miss. Add 3.
Now 1 again (index 3). Look it up — hit! 1 is already in the set, first seen at index 0.
A value repeated, so we stop and return true. Reaching the end with no hit would mean every value is distinct — false.
